title.zh: 【德国储蓄银行开始逐步上线加密货币交易服务】
title.en: 【德国储蓄银行开始逐步上线加密货币交易服务】

current_state.zh:
据德国储蓄银行与汇划银行协会（DSGV）消息，自 10 月 19 日起，首批参与的德国储蓄银行（Sparkassen）客户可通过现有的储蓄银行 App 交易加密货币。首批支持的币种包括 BTC、ETH、XRP、SOL 及 POL，各家储蓄银行自行决定上线时间，此后预计每月新增 30 至 40 家机构接入。

此举使加密货币交易能够在受监管的前提下，进入德国覆盖面最广的本地银行网络。据 DSGV 官网数据，截至 2026 年 8 月德国共有 337 家独立运营的储蓄银行；协会计划在 2027 年上半年覆盖大部分有意参与的储蓄银行。

该服务由储蓄银行集团旗下证券服务商 DekaBank 提供，加密资产由 DekaBank 与斯图加特证券交易所合作托管，每笔订单收费约 0.99 欧元（约 1.11 美元）。DSGV 表示，服务面向希望自主买卖和托管加密货币的客户，储蓄银行不会提供投资建议，也不会大范围主动推广，并会明确提示客户注意价格大幅波动及全部亏损的风险。
current_state.en: Germany's savings banks began a phased rollout of crypto trading through their existing apps on Oct. 19, starting with BTC, ETH, XRP, SOL and POL, DekaBank custody and a €0.99 per-order fee, with broad coverage targeted by H1 2027.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Germany's savings banks began a phased rollout of crypto trading through their existing apps on Oct. 19, starting with BTC, ETH, XRP, SOL and POL, DekaBank custody and a €0.99 per-order fee, with broad coverage targeted by H1 2027.
updates.background_zh: DSGV 是德国储蓄银行的上层协会，也是储蓄银行金融集团（Sparkassen-Finanzgruppe）的顶层机构；据维基百科，该集团是德国和欧洲资产规模最大的金融服务集团。DekaBank 此前已在斯图加特证券交易所数字资产部门的支持下，面向机构客户推出加密交易与托管服务。DSGV 管理层成员 Joachim Schmalzl 表示，入局的决定性因素是客户需求强劲以及欧洲目前已具备可靠的监管框架，并强调传统证券投资、储蓄计划与财务咨询仍是集团核心业务。
updates.background_en: DSGV is the umbrella association of German savings banks and the apex entity of the Sparkassen-Finanzgruppe, which Wikipedia describes as the largest financial services group in Germany and Europe by assets. DekaBank had already rolled out crypto trading and custody services for institutional clients, supported by the digital assets unit of the Stuttgart Stock Exchange. DSGV management board member Joachim Schmalzl attributed the decision to strong customer demand and the reliable regulatory framework now in place in Europe, adding that traditional securities, savings plans and financial advice remain the group's core business.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次上线为欧洲最大的银行市场增加了一条受监管的散户入场通道，BTC、ETH、XRP、SOL 和 POL 的订单经由 DekaBank 与斯图加特证券交易所的托管体系处理，可能逐步提升这五种资产在欧元区境内的流动性与托管集中度。每笔 0.99 欧元的定价也使储蓄银行与 N26、Trade Republic 等手机银行形成直接竞争，但各家机构自愿、分批上线的节奏限制了短期成交量的实际影响。
updates.market_impact_en: The rollout adds a regulated retail access channel in Europe's largest banking market, routing orders for BTC, ETH, XRP, SOL and POL through DekaBank and Stuttgart Stock Exchange custody, which could gradually deepen onshore euro liquidity and custody concentration for those five assets. At €0.99 per order, the pricing also puts savings banks in direct competition with mobile brokers such as N26 and Trade Republic, though the gradual, opt-in pace limits near-term volume effects.
